architecture_decision: Do not extrapolate the pinned production histories below a_on to manufacture a growing-mode selector. Keep the unresolved seed explicitly UV/pre-EFT matched at this stage.
next_gate: freeze C10.65l explicit pre-EFT/UV matching-interface contract for the eight fixed-C2 C10.65i amplitudes plus C2: define the minimal gauge-invariant boundary data and a phenomenological control prescription without claiming it is derived by the low-energy completed action; only then build conditional completed-U1 seeds and onset-shift tests
non_claims: not a proof that the UV theory cannot select a unique growing mode
not a proof that the analytic Khronon background fails before a_on
not a choice of C2 or of the eight temporal amplitudes

selector_consequence.later_time_boundedness: Would be a new phenomenological final-time boundary condition, not silently equivalent to primordial growing-mode selection.
selector_consequence.required_boundary_class: explicit pre-EFT/UV matching functional for C2 and the eight C10.65i fixed-C2 temporal amplitudes, unless a new independently certified earlier completed-U1 background branch is constructed

why_analytic_extension_is_not_enough.Khronon: The analytic action-fluid background can be evaluated for positive a, but this certifies only that sector.
why_analytic_extension_is_not_enough.background_scope_guard: The first implementation may use the pinned production background only as a diagnostic matching branch. It must label the result scoped until the independent same-full-action Friedmann/gravity-normalization gate is closed.
why_analytic_extension_is_not_enough.coupled_background: The completed projector needs H and total/ordinary source background data. Extending those below persisted production support would be a new assumption, not a consequence of the existing certificates.
why_analytic_extension_is_not_enough.metric: Historical CLASS phi/psi are read-only controls and cannot be used as the completed-U1 backward metric trajectory.
